name: Glenstone dust
description: Honey-grey grit swept from a mason's floor. The valley's whole fortune started as this, and most of it is still on the floor.
notes: Potion ingredient (mw-ju8.4): shop and loot stock only, with no use until a brewing system lands (a later bead). Fine freestone powder from the quarries and galleries. Base value 12 sits in the economy ingredient band (3-15).
